purpose: Repair the previously identified Orion-P load-state mismatch and test two fixed ordinal consensus rules between the frozen FaaSRank exploitation score and the load-faithful Orion-P score on fresh E81-E85; all 60 runs remain blinded until QC and pairing complete.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E81-E85 were declared in the V33 full source manifest but were never captured, referenced, executed, or inspected; E21-E80 are closed and E11-E20 remain sealed.

source.high_profile_note: Frozen high remains 7k; V34 is low only.

diagnostic_basis.closed_v33_observation: The three Jiagu-P forecast-semantic candidates all failed the combined low-load gate on E76-E80. Orion had the highest baseline mean fixed-window throughput and FaaSRank had the highest baseline mean QPR.
diagnostic_basis.code_audit_before_v34_capture: The frozen Orion-P baseline scores node load as Node::all_task_cnt() plus same-window projected assignments; all_task_cnt() includes pending plus running tasks. The legacy NSESche Orion expert used resident/running plus projected assignments and therefore omitted pending tasks. Its utilization, warm/starting-container, parent-locality, 0.40/0.30/0.20/0.10 weights, and critical-path player order otherwise match the frozen baseline semantics used by this bounded test.
diagnostic_basis.candidate_a_semantic_repair: Use the load-faithful Orion-P score with pending plus running plus projected tasks, leaving the legacy Orion expert available as a rollback point.
diagnostic_basis.candidate_b_joint_consensus: Use equal-vote ordinal Borda over the frozen FaaSRank exploitation score and the load-faithful Orion-P score, with node ID as the existing deterministic final tie-break.
diagnostic_basis.candidate_c_qpr_majority_control: Use the preregistered small-integer 2:1 ordinal Borda vote profile favoring FaaSRank over load-faithful Orion-P; no continuous coefficient is fitted.

router_inputs: current pending and running task counts
current DAG parent placement and frozen function/resource attributes

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit before capture; build and run serially; reveal after all QC and pairing.

eligibility_per_candidate: mean fixed-window throughput strictly exceeds all nine baseline means
mean QPR strictly exceeds all nine baseline means
frozen V8 middle/high retain first place in both metrics
selection_rule: Freeze the first passing candidate in fixed v34b, v34c, v34a priority (balanced joint consensus, then FaaSRank-majority consensus, then the pure semantic repair); ties fail; otherwise select none and close E81-E85.

confirmation.closure_requirement: First in mean throughput and QPR for every load against frozen E11-E20 baselines.
